description:
• Brand introduction: Australian Naturopathic Skincare - Founded with a purpose, inspired by Nature. Wyuna Botanicals was founded to create natural skincare for those with allergies and sensitive skin. We blend our evidence-based approach with our love for plants to create natural skincare that works.

• Product description: Misty Mushroom Face Spritz
Hydrate your skin anytime, anywhere. Misty Mushroom Face Spritz sets and prolongs your makeup. Helps layer between skin routine steps and is your afternoon pick me up. Rejuvenates without weighing you down. Each spritz is pore-tightening and provides a burst of hydration leaving you looking dewy and radiant. Your perfect companion for on the go hydration.

Benefits:
✓ Plumper, more hydrated skin
✓ Preps skin
✓ Evens skin tone
✓ Brightens dull skin
✓ Reduces appearance of large pores

Key Ingredients:
Reishi Mushroom • Desert Lime • Kangaroo Paw • Aloe Vera

Misty Mushroom Face spritz gently tones and preps skin between skin routine steps. It's enriched with anti-inflammatory botanicals to reduce skin redness, irritation, and puffiness. Reishi Mushroom is rich in beta glucans and helps to retain moisture.

Safe during pregnancy and breastfeeding. pH Balanced.

• USP (Unique Selling Point): Our formulation process always considers those who have reactive and sensitive skin. We use certified organic Ingredients and blend herbal and native Australian extracts to reconnect to nature. We understand many people have allergies and we pride ourselves on being transparent with our products. All our skincare products are free from tree nuts and peanuts as our co-founder is anaphylactic to nuts!

• Payment terms: for more information, please contact info@wyunabotanicals.com

Welcome to Wyuna Botanicals! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as the merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Registration & Eligibility
We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration. Affiliates must be at least 18 years old and reside in Australia.You must have an active and relevant online presence (social media, blog, or other platform). We reserve the right to accept or reject applications at our sole discretion.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon
Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

3. Commissions and payment
Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. The Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

Orders are reviewed weekly on a Wednesday and once approved, payments are made via your affiliate portal.

Payments are made weekly via the affiliate portal (e.g., PayPal or direct deposit).

4. Marketing tool
We may share promotion medias such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share onto affiliate channels.

5. Network
If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Personal Discounts

Affiliates receive 30% off personal use products, intended for the affiliate only. Abuse (e.g., reselling or sharing the code) will result in removal from the program.

7. Prohibited Activities

Do not make false or misleading claims about Wyuna Botanicals products.

Affiliates may not run paid ads using Wyuna Botanicals’ branded keywords (e.g., “Wyuna Botanicals”).

Do not spam links or engage in aggressive or unethical promotion.

Affiliate content must not make therapeutic claims.

8. Content Guidelines

Disclose your affiliate relationship (e.g., “I may earn a commission if you purchase via my link”).

Content must reflect the Wyuna Botanicals brand: honest, respectful, natural, and inclusive.

We reserve the right to request removal of any content that misrepresents the brand.

9. Use Of Intellectual Properties

Affiliates are granted a non-exclusive, revocable license to use Wyuna Botanicals’ assets (logos, images, etc.) solely for promotional purposes.

All brand assets remain the intellectual property of Wyuna Botanicals.


10. Cookie
We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is stated in the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

11. Removal from Referral Program
If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@wyunabotanicals.com. 

12. Modifications

Wyuna Botanicals may update these terms at any time. Continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@wyunabotanicals.com for support.
